expect.body: 4 days full using of public transport.

expect.title: Accommodation
expect.body: Rooms are small typically 10-16sqf (Japan standard). Triple rooms offer even less space.

expect.title: Lot of Walking
expect.body: Will be using public transport for day tour.

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage per person as it will affect car capacity.

expect.title: Meal
expect.body: Exclude lunch and dinner. Guide will bring to Halal or Muslim Friendly restaurant.

expect.title: Not Mentioned in the Itinerary
expect.body: Things not mentioned in the itinerary must be paid by customers. Eg: Entrance Fee, Shopping etc.

expect.title: Stairs

expect.body: 10 hours basis. 5,000 - 10,000 yen will be charged for each extra hour.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if booking made less than 45 days of departure.
Last Minute Surcharge will be charged if booking made less than 3 weeks of departure (refer to the Last Minute Surcharge table).
This package is valid until 31st December 2026 travel period.
Private Driver & Guide is based on 10 hours basis. 5,000 - 10,000 yen will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash.
Customers are recommended to take AirAsia X flight from Kuala Lumpur to Haneda Airport to match the default itinerary.
Itinerary, price and flight are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements 14 days before trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity or before booking any connecting domestic flights.
